Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe has a ruling: A common online 'misprint' of the 7-side states that 'Your Force drains at battleground systems where you have a Star Destroyer are each +2 (or +1 if that Star Destroyer is Victory-class).' but the correct text found on all physical copies of the card is 'Your Force drains at battleground systems where you have a Star Destroyer are each +1 (or +2 if that Star Destroyer is Imperial- or Super-class).'

Kessel Run has a ruling: If Light moving from Kessel to another system would complete Kessel Run, but also gives Dark control of Kessel which would cancel Kessel Run, resolve as competing automatic actions (the player whose turn it is chooses whether to complete or cancel). Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (V) has a ruling: (7-side) Light may react to a single battle with both Luke and a weapon, but if doing so, they are two separate react actions performed one at a time. It Light reacts to a Force drain with Luke, this will typically cancel the Force drain, preventing further reacts. Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (V) has a ruling: (7-side) Placing a completed Jedi Test out of play may be performed multiple times per turn.

Quinlan Vos has a ruling: If the battle is at Quinlan's location but Quinlan is excluded from the battle, he is inactive and does not make Dark Approach a Used Interrupt.
